# 16: One Generated Doc header per package

**What to build:** All five generators build the same header by hand (front matter with `kind: generated`, `generator`, `source`, the title and the "Generated by `pnpm docs:generate`. Do not edit by hand." line): `scripts/docs/adr-index.ts`, `scripts/docs/package-graph.ts`, `packages/api/src/docs/er-diagram.ts`, `packages/api/src/docs/routes.ts` and `packages/contracts/src/realtime-events-doc.ts`. Extract a small helper so each package (scripts, api) builds it in one place; contracts has one generator and keeps its own or uses one if a shared home fits without a new dependency. Found in the spec's final code review.
